content_data.meeting_title: Visual Identity Workshop for 'Harvest Hub' Launch
agenda_items: Outline next steps for visual asset creation and style guide development
Review competitor visual landscape and brand differentiators
Brainstorm core visual metaphors and mood board concepts
key_decisions: Agreed on a fresh, nature-inspired aesthetic with a modern, tech-forward edge for 'Harvest Hub'.
Confirmed the need for a comprehensive brand style guide to ensure consistency across all touchpoints.
Decided to explore three distinct logo concepts further, focusing on scalability and digital adaptability.
action_items: Draft core brand messaging and tone guidelines for review (Marketing Lead, by end of next week).
Schedule follow-up meeting to review initial visual concepts and brand messaging (Project Manager, for 2 weeks from now).
